newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Student protesters jostle Australia's Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Student protesters jostle Australia's Howard.

text.p: Angry university students protesting against higher tuition fees jostled Australian Prime Minister John Howard as he arrived to speak at a graduation ceremony on Friday.

A group of about 30 protesters surged towards Howard as he got out of his official car, pushing him and his bodyguards as they walked about 10 metres (yards) to the Great Hall of the University of Sydney, witnesses said.
Some police surrounding Howard were shoved and punched and one of Howard's staffers fell in the melee, grazing her knee.
Howard's car was again mobbed as he left the university, forcing a police cordon surrounding the car to drag protestors away from in front of the car.
A series of running scuffles between police and the protestors broke out as Howard's car inched its way off the university grounds.
A police spokesman later said one protester was detained as Howard left the building, but was later released. A policeman had sought medical treatment after being kicked in the shin.
Howard's conservative government announced education funding cuts earlier this year and higher university tuition fees as part of the wider push to cut government spending and the budget deficit.
